title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.

title: Effect on Model Complexity
text: By potentially reducing the number of features, LASSO can decrease model complexity. How might this affect the model's performance on unseen data?

title: Impact on Test MSE
text: Consider how reducing model complexity with LASSO might affect overfitting. What are the possible effects on the MSE of held-out test data?
